correctness.rationale: For full resetting, the stationary age has Exp(r) law and the exact unit-projection conditional variance is V(t)=2D[t+gamma*u*v*t^2+gamma^2*u^2*t^3/3]. Direct integration when gamma*u=0 gives the Laplace density and finite MGF. When gamma*u!=0, saddle t=ell*sqrt(abs(z)), with F(s)=s+1/(3s^3), unique s=1, F(1)=4/3, F''=4, yields K*abs(z)^(-1/2)*exp(-B*sqrt(abs(z))); the c2 correction gives exp(r*v/(gamma*u)). Small/large t tails are suppressed relative to the saddle. All polynomial moments exist by exponential age mixing; the finite two-sided Hamburger Krein logarithmic integral establishes indeterminacy; absence of MGF alone would not. Independent symbolic variance and constant checks passed. No joint-law determinacy or uniform gamma*u->0 statement is proved.
